fullPassage: The "set point theory" concept is that your body has a stable quantity of fat cells by the time you are an adult. The more weight you carried in your childhood and your teenage years, the more fat cells you will have as an adult. These fat cells then become "fuller" or "thinner" as you gain and lose weight as an adult. The set point is the trigger in these cells that will send a message to your brain saying that your fat cells are getting too thin and that you must eat more. Different people's fat cells will have different set points, and the strength of the message is affected by the number of cells. Some researchers report that fat cells can release hormones and other chemicals that could help treat a disease. Thus a person with lots of fat cells and a high set point will battle with a strong desire for food when dieting.

questions.passage: The "set point theory" concept is that your body has a (A) quantity of fat cells by the time you are an adult. The set point is the trigger in these cells that will send a message to your brain saying that your fat cells are getting too thin and that you must eat more. Thus a person with lots of fat cells and a high set point will (B) with a strong (C) for food when dieting.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 몸에는 안정적인(stable) 양의 지방세포가 있고, 높은 설정점을 가진 사람은 다이어트 시 음식에 대한 강한 욕구(desire)와 싸우게(battle) 된다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① stable — battle — desire: 원문 일치
❌ ② unstable: stable의 반의어
❌ ③ retreat: battle의 반의어
❌ ④ aversion: desire의 반의어
det.tip: stable(안정적) ↔ unstable | battle(싸우다) ↔ retreat(후퇴) | desire(욕구) ↔ aversion(혐오)

questions.passage: The more weight you carried in your childhood and your teenage years, the more fat cells you will have as an adult. These fat cells then become "fuller" or "thinner" as you (A) and (B) weight as an adult. The set point is the (C) in these cells that will send a message to your brain.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 성인이 되어 체중을 얻고(gain) 잃으면서(lose) 지방세포가 변하고, 설정점은 뇌에 메시지를 보내는 방아쇠(trigger)이다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① gain — lose — trigger: 원문 일치
❌ ② lose — gain: 순서 반대
❌ ③ barrier: trigger가 아닌 다른 의미
❌ ④ maintain: gain이 아닌 다른 의미
det.tip: gain weight(체중 증가) ↔ lose weight(체중 감소) | trigger(방아쇠, 유발 요인)

questions.passage: The "set point theory" concept is that your body has a ①<u>stable</u> quantity of fat cells by the time you are an adult. The more weight you carried in your childhood and your teenage years, the more fat cells you will have as an adult. These fat cells then become "fuller" or "thinner" as you gain and lose weight as an adult. The set point is the ②<u>trigger</u> in these cells that will send a message to your brain saying that your fat cells are getting too thin and that you must eat more. Different people's fat cells will have different set points, and the ③<u>weakness</u> of the message is affected by the number of cells. Thus a person with lots of fat cells and a high set point will ④<u>battle</u> with a strong desire for food when dieting.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 메시지의 강도(strength)가 세포 수에 영향을 받는다. ③ weakness(약함)는 strength의 반의어로 부적절.
det.analysis:
❌ ③ weakness: 원문은 strength → 메시지의 강도
✅ ①②④: 원문 일치
det.tip: strength(강도) ↔ weakness(약함) — 세포 수가 많을수록 메시지가 강해짐

questions.passage: The "set point theory" concept is that your body has a stable quantity of fat cells by the time you are an adult. The more weight you carried in your childhood and your teenage years, the more fat cells you will have as an adult. These fat cells then become "fuller" or "thinner" as you gain and lose weight as an adult. The set point is the trigger in these cells that will send a message to your brain saying that your fat cells are getting too ①<u>thin</u> and that you must eat more. Different people's fat cells will have different set points, and the strength of the message is ②<u>affected</u> by the number of cells. Some researchers report that fat cells can ③<u>absorb</u> hormones and other chemicals that could help treat a disease. Thus a person with lots of fat cells and a high set point will battle with a strong ④<u>desire</u> for food when dieting.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 지방세포가 호르몬과 화학물질을 방출(release)할 수 있다. ③ absorb(흡수하다)는 release의 반의어로 부적절.
det.analysis:
❌ ③ absorb: 원문은 release → 호르몬을 방출
✅ ①②④: 원문 일치
det.tip: release(방출) ↔ absorb(흡수) — 지방세포가 호르몬을 내보내는 것

questions.passage: The "set point theory" concept is that your body has a <u>stable</u> quantity of fat cells by the time you are an adult.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 stable의 의미와 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: stable = 안정적인 → steady = 변함없는, 꾸준한 → 동의어
det.analysis:
✅ ② steady: stable의 동의어
❌ ① variable: 반의어
❌ ③ temporary: 일시적인
❌ ④ random: 무작위의
det.tip: stable = steady = constant = 안정적인 ↔ variable(변동하는)

questions.passage: The set point is the <u>trigger</u> in these cells that will send a message to your brain.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 trigger의 의미와 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: trigger = 방아쇠, 촉발 요인 → stimulus = 자극, 유발 요인 → 동의어
det.analysis:
✅ ③ stimulus: trigger의 동의어 (자극, 유발 요인)
❌ ① obstacle: 장애물
❌ ② outcome: 결과
❌ ④ symptom: 증상
det.tip: trigger = stimulus = catalyst = 촉발 요인 ↔ obstacle(장애물)

questions.passage: Thus a person with lots of fat cells and a high set point will battle with a strong <u>desire</u> for food when dieting.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 desire의 의미와 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: desire = 욕구, 바람 → craving = 갈망, 강한 욕구 → 동의어
det.analysis:
✅ ① craving: desire의 동의어 (갈망)
❌ ② hatred: 혐오
❌ ③ fear: 두려움
❌ ④ indifference: 무관심
det.tip: desire = craving = longing = 욕구, 갈망 ↔ aversion(혐오)

questions.passage: These fat cells then become "fuller" or "thinner" as you <u>gain</u> and lose weight as an adult.

det.analysis:
❌ ④ lose: gain의 반의어
✅ ① obtain: 유사어
✅ ② acquire: 유사어
✅ ③ earn: 유사어

questions.passage: Different people's fat cells will have different set points, and the <u>strength</u> of the message is affected by the number of cells.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 strength의 의미와 가장 먼 것은?

det.korean: strength = 강도, 힘 ↔ weakness = 약함, 허약함
det.analysis:
❌ ③ weakness: strength의 반의어
✅ ① power: 유사어
✅ ② intensity: 유사어
✅ ④ force: 유사어

questions.passage: The set point is the trigger in these cells that will send a __________ to your brain saying that your fat cells are getting too thin and that you must eat more.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 세포가 뇌에 메시지(message)를 보낸다.
det.analysis:

❌ ③ command: 부적절

questions.passage: Some researchers report that fat cells can __________ hormones and other chemicals that could help treat a disease.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
